about_the_game:
The Dark Legacy is a psychological horror game played from a first-person perspective, where you step into a decaying estate left behind by a man who believed death could be reversed.

The house belonged to Dr. Victor Halberg, a once-celebrated brain surgeon who spiraled into obsession after the sudden death of his wife. Isolated from the world, he transformed his home into a hidden laboratory, where science crossed into madness and memory refused to fade.

You are John Halberg, his estranged grandson. Broke and desperate, you return to claim your inheritance — a crumbling estate lost to time and rumor.

What begins as a simple inspection for resale slowly becomes a descent into a forgotten experiment that was never truly abandoned. You uncover scattered records, distorted audio logs, and glimpses of a consciousness that should not exist.

As night falls, the house awakens. And the legacy you thought was buried… remembers you.

🎮 Gameplay

The Dark Legacy focuses on exploration, tension, and psychological unease rather than combat. Players freely navigate the decaying estate, solve environmental puzzles, listen to disturbing audio logs, and piece together a fragmented past.

Every step may awaken a memory. Every room hides a secret.
And some questions are best left unanswered.

content_descriptors.notes: The Dark Legacy contains strong psychological horror and graphic violence, including realistic blood and gore effects, sudden jump scares, and unsettling ambient audio. There is no sexual content, drug use, self-harm themes, or animal cruelty in this demo.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K @ 3.5 GHz OR AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 OR AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10240 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K @ 4.2 GHz OR AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB OR AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20480  MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: The Dark Legacy is a first-person psychological horror set in an abandoned surgeon’s home. Every room holds an unfinished experiment. Every wall hides a silenced scream. In a house where death was denied, escape means remembering.
